newsitem.title: UK: Premier League weighs options,Sky deal safe.
newsitem.headline: Premier League weighs options,Sky deal safe.

text.p: Soccer Premier League said on Wedesday it had to research and keep up with developments in order to decide any future television deals after its current deal with BSkyB expires in 2001.
"That is a sensible way to organise business and does not reflect a decision," chief executive of the FA Premier League Peter Leaver said in a statement.

He added that a current four-year agreement with British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc was binding and there was "no question" of termination ahead of 2001, nor were any meetings planned to discuss such a possibility.
He described newspaper speculation about current and future television deals as "both inaccurate and mischievous".
